author: Linnaeus, 1758
summary: 동해안과 남해안에서 적은 수가 겨울을 나는 매우 드문 겨울철새다. 다른 기러기와 달리 육지 깊숙이 바다가 들어온 만이나 해안에서 주로 겨울을 지내며, 먹이도 주로 바다의 해초류다. 유라시아 대륙, 북아메리카, 그린란드 북극권의 툰드라 호수와 갯벌 강기슭, 강 하구에서 번식하는데, 땅 위나 바위 틈에 이끼로 접시 모양 둥지를 짓고 회백색 알을 3~8개 낳는다. 한국, 일본, 중국 해안, 북미 서부 연안 등지에서 겨울을 난다.

art.subject: Brant Goose (Branta bernicla nigricans, the dark Pacific form 'Black Brant'), adult, sexes alike, in winter: head, neck and breast black; a broad white collar of fine white bars on the upper neck, widest at the sides and usually joined across the front of the throat; mantle, back and wings dark sooty blackish-brown; belly and flanks dark sooty-brown, with a contrasting whitish patch of pale bars along the upper flanks at the waterline; vent and uppertail coverts white, almost covering the short black tail; bill small and black; dark eye; legs black.
art.pose: swimming close to the shore, feeding on seaweed
art.scene: sheltered bay on the Korean east coast in winter, calm sea water along a rocky shore with seaweed; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view swimming: black head, neck and breast, white collar on the upper neck, sooty blackish-brown back and flanks with a pale barred patch along the upper flanks, white stern
adult, head and neck detail in profile: small black head and short black bill, short thick black neck with a broad white collar of fine bars on the upper neck
art.build: Small, compact sea goose, about 61cm, only a little bigger than a Mallard; short thick neck, small rounded head and small bill, much shorter than the head. Floats high and buoyant on the sea, upending to feed on eelgrass and seaweed. Legs short, black. At rest the wingtips reach about the tail tip. Tail short and black, nearly hidden by the white tail coverts. In flight all dark with a white rear end; flies low over the sea in loose lines.
avoid: Do not paint white cheeks or a white chinstrap; that is Cackling or Canada Goose.
Do not paint a long neck or long bill; the neck is short and thick.
Do not paint a pale grey-brown belly; in this Pacific form the belly is dark sooty, only the flank patch and stern are pale.
Do not paint a white face or a barred grey back (Barnacle Goose).
